title: Data Grid
description: Sortable, searchable, filterable table with selection, column toggles and pagination, built on TanStack Table.

a11y.motion: Nothing in the table animates. The selection bar fades in only when reduced motion is off.
a11y.keyboard: Sortable headers are buttons: Tab reaches them and Enter or Space cycles ascending, descending and unsorted. Search, filter and column menus, row checkboxes and pagination are all native or Radix controls reachable with Tab; menus use arrow keys.
a11y.screenReader: A named table whose sortable headers report aria-sort. Every checkbox and icon button has a label, and the result range ("1–10 of 48") is a polite live region, so filtering announces how many rows match.
